packageRules.description: nvidia-*-cu13 packages are transitive dependencies pinned exactly by torch; do not bump them independently
numpy is capped at <2.4 by paddlex (via paddleocr); do not bump until a paddlex release supports numpy 2.5+

transformers and tokenizers are coupled under sentence-transformers and must be updated together; grouping avoids partial updates that break resolution (e.g. transformers 5.16.1 requires tokenizers>=0.23.1 while tokenizers stayed at 0.22.2)
vue-tsc cannot consume TypeScript 7: TS 7 no longer exposes the typescript/lib/tsc subpath that vue-tsc loads, so the type-check/build CI fails at runtime (ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED)

websockets is capped at <16 to match the declared constraint in requirements.txt (langgraph-sdk resolves websockets>=14,,<17); scoped to requirements.txt via matchFileNames so the separate Vercel deployment's websockets==17.0.1 pin in requirements.vercel.txt is not affected
